title: Floating Panel: KRunner pop up clips into floating top Panel.
line: KRunner at the top of the screen now opens below a floating top panel instead of overlapping it.
explanation: A floating panel's exclusive zone is only its thickness, so maximized windows can slide under the floating gap. KRunner in its top position is a layer-shell surface placed at the edge of that exclusive zone, so it started inside the floating gap and overlapped the panel's lower edge by about 8 px. Plasmashell now publishes, on its own org.kde.PlasmaShell D-Bus interface (internal API, like grabContainmentImage), the extra space that floating panels which reserve space take on each screen edge, with a change signal; only normal panels count, and only while they float. KRunner keeps those values cached through asynchronous calls and uses the top one as its layer-shell margin, so it opens just below the panel without ever waiting for plasmashell.

commits.message:
krunner: place the top bar below floating panels

Floating panels only reserve their thickness, so KRunner at the top of
the screen overlapped a floating top panel. Plasmashell now tells it how
much more space such panels take, and KRunner keeps that much below them.

BUG: 502508
